name: Plainstrider Feather
summary: On Red Cloud Mesa, young hunters gather Plainstrider Feather from the birds roaming Mulgore’s plains. Camp Narache uses them for clothing and tribal adornments, honoring the creatures that provide for the village.

sections.title: A Hunter's First Offering
sections.body: Young tauren on Red Cloud Mesa learn to track and hunt for what the tribe needs. Plainstriders roam the grassy plateau, providing food and useful feathers. Camp Narache makes garments and gear from their plumage. Young hunters bring feathers and fresh meat to Grull Hawkwind to meet the camp’s needs. The offering is their first test before Chief Hawkwind recognizes them and welcomes them in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: What are Plainstrider Feathers used for?
faq.answer: Camp Narache uses Plainstrider Feathers to make clothing and ceremonial items. Grull Hawkwind gathers them from young hunters to replenish tribal supplies.

faq.q: Who gathers Plainstrider Feathers on Red Cloud Mesa?
faq.answer: Young hunters gather Plainstrider Feathers on Red Cloud Mesa at Grull Hawkwind’s request. He replenishes Camp Narache’s stores and tests their discipline in providing for the tribe.
Plainstriders roam the open grasslands of Red Cloud Mesa and the rolling plains of Mulgore.

faq.q: Why does Grull Hawkwind require these feathers for tribal rites?
faq.answer: Hunting provides for survival and sport in tauren culture. Bringing meat and plumage back to Chief Hawkwind shows that a young hunter can sustain the tribe before going on to Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a young tauren, gathering a plainstrider’s feathers teaches you to value the Earth Mother’s creatures and use each part of the kill for food and clothing.
As a hunter, stalking swift plainstriders across Red Cloud Mesa tests your patience and tracking, and teaches you to honor your quarry.
